The capping_config.pt files themselves do not contain benchmark scores or harm-reduction fields.

Recommended Gemma layer range

Qwen maps to Gemma layers_33:39-p0.25, covering layer indices 33 through 38.
Llama maps to Gemma layers_32:41-p0.25 by nearest-boundary rounding, covering layer indices 32 through 40.
Because the Llama setting is the broader validated capping range and contains the Qwen-equivalent late-middle region, the practical Gemma calibration recommendation is to start with layers_32:41-p0.25 and include layers_33:39-p0.25 as the narrower ablation. If matching the inclusive Llama layer span 56 through 71 by endpoint coverage rather than slice-boundary rounding, test layers_32:42-p0.25 as the inclusive-safe variant covering layer indices 32 through 41.

Caveat

The published configs are for Qwen 3 32B and Llama 3.3 70B, not Gemma 2 27B. The Gemma recommendation is a proportional calibration target, not a validated Gemma capping result.
